name: Tab Shortcuts for Google Chrome™
description: Custom keyboard shortcuts for 14 tab actions: duplicate, reload, pin, group, mute sites, close tabs, reopen closed tabs, and more.

add-to-new-group.description: Add active tab to a new group

move-to-new-window.description: Move active tab to a new window

toggle-mute-site.description: Mute or unmute the active site

add-to-reading-list.description: Add active tab to Reading List

close-tabs-to-right.description: Close unpinned tabs to the right

reopen-closed-tab.description: Reopen the most recently closed tab or window

bookmark-all-tabs.description: Bookmark every eligible tab in the current window
